content.html: The model for one delivery from the first warehouse, S = \(\frac{96 + 24x}{2 + x}\) , is the same as S = \(\frac{24 (4 + x)}{2 + x}\) . This model can be changed when there are more deliveries. Each delivery is a distance of x km on busy roads from the previous delivery.
content.text: The model for one delivery from the first warehouse, S = (96+24x)/(2+x) , is the same as S = (24(4+x))/(2+x) . This model can be changed when there are more deliveries. Each delivery is a distance of x km on busy roads from the previous delivery.
